Name: Luna Cat Replacer
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tT5YaQt.gif[/img]


Someone requested a mod that replaces the cat with Luna from Sailor Moon. Here is my best rendition:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MxsssDE.png[/img] 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4tlIu3z.png[/img] 

[b]Download:[/b]

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/188/?tab=2&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmodfiles%2F%3Fid%3D188&pUp=1]Download Here[/url] on the Nexus (just click the file name or "download manually")


[b][b]Installation Instructions:[/b][/b]

[list]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Animals 
[*]Replace the cat.xnb file with the one from the download
[/list]

*You can easily create a backup of your original cat.xnb file by renaming it to something silly. I do cat.xnbOLD for myself.

[b]Credit: [/b]Lots of thanks to @Korokos for giving me permission to recolor their sprite from the [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/longhair-cats-two-new-colors-3-25.111316/]Longhair Cats[/url] mod (which is vastly superior to the base game cat!)[b] [/b]
